**About The Role**
 As a Software Engineer, Provider Growth at Forus, you will build the systems that determine how quickly our provider network expands and how effectively new practices become active users of the platform. You will work across the full growth journey, from provider onboarding and the core dashboard experience to the tools, automation, and experiments that help us identify, reach, activate, and support providers at scale.

* Set the technical direction for Provider Growth, making architecture and platform decisions that support rapid experimentation without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Build AI agents and automation that expand our provider network, including systems for lead qualification, data enrichment, outreach, and follow\-up across channels.
* Design and ship tools that help Growth and Operations teams move faster, replacing manual work with scalable systems wherever possible.
* Run experiments across onboarding, activation, referral, and other growth surfaces, using data to identify what improves conversion, adoption, and sustained usage.
* Define the metrics and instrumentation that let us understand the provider funnel and prioritize the highest\-leverage opportunities.

**About Cinder**
 Cinder is the mission\-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working.
   

  

 Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated.
   

  

 We're a small, fast\-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems.
   

  

**Why This Role**
 Cinder is expanding quickly, and we want to bring on an additional AI Engineer to partner with our current AI Engineers, Data Scientist, and Data Engineer. You'll build the ML systems that make Cinder faster, more efficient, and more accurate, turning the enormous volume of customer decision data we process into production models that directly shape customer outcomes.
   

  

 We're looking for a builder. Someone who has taken models from messy data to production at scale, who reaches for a gradient\-boosted tree before a transformer when that's the right call, and who has stood up ML infrastructure from scratch rather than inheriting it fully\-built. What matters most is judgment: knowing the smallest, most efficient, most reliable model for the job, and understanding both ML methods and LLMs deeply enough to make that call yourself rather than defaulting to whichever one you know best. This role needs someone who cares as much about precision\-recall tradeoffs, class imbalance, and serving latency as they do about model architecture.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Turn real\-world customer data into something a model can actually learn from, then decide what model approach fits: a classical classifier when it wins on cost and latency, a fine\-tuned LLM when the tradeoff is worth it, a third\-party API as a bootstrap. You own the full path from data to decision, not just the model.
* Improve our classification pipeline, confidence cascading, and detection strategies so we catch harmful content efficiently — balancing cost, latency, and accuracy deliberately.
* Develop intelligent features that help moderators make decisions, organize platform content, and reveal patterns across our data.
* Partner with Engineering to build out Cinder's in\-house model training, hosting, and inference platform.
* Design and build the evaluation and metrics infrastructure customers rely on, including how classifier scores and model outputs are calculated, stored, surfaced, and iterated on.
* Partner with our Founding Data Scientist and AI Engineers to shape the agent evaluation architecture — measuring whether our agent fleet is making the right decisions with the right tools at the right cost.
* Partner with our Data Engineer to shape the data infrastructure powering our ML systems, ensuring model training, feature pipelines, and production inference have the right data flowing at the right latency and scale.
* Mentor teammates and raise the ML bar across the company as Cinder's ML capability matures.


**What we’re looking for**
* 5–8\+ years of machine learning engineering experience on a small team, with a strong track record of shipping ML systems (gradient boosting, tree\-based models, classifiers, embedding\-based methods) to production.
* You've taken a classification problem from messy, unlabeled, real\-world data all the way to a model that shipped and served production traffic.
* You understand LLMs well enough to make an informed, defensible call about when an LLM is worth its cost and latency versus a classic model.
* Real, hands\-on experience building classifiers under severe class imbalance, where the signal you care about is a small minority of the data
* Thrived in environments where the ML infrastructure wasn't already built for you: you've stood up training pipelines, serving infrastructure, evaluation harnesses, and monitoring from scratch rather than inheriting a mature platform.
* Startup or small/mid\-size company experience where you owned meaningful scope and had to make pragmatic tradeoffs about what to build, what to buy, and what to defer.

Within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, you will apply data, algorithms, and software engineering to build and deploy AI and Machine Learning solutions at scale, enabling informed decision\-making and innovation.
   

  

 As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities for growth. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for our clients and success as a team, building a personal brand and opening doors to more opportunities.
   

  

 In this role at PwC, you will engage in designing AI systems, data wrangling, and software implementation to enable scalable AI models. You will be part of a fast\-paced environment, where every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow, contributing to the firm's success and your professional development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Designing and implementing AI systems using Python and machine learning libraries such as Scikit\-Learn
* Developing data pipelines and models to transform raw data into actionable insights for clients
* Collaborating with team members to support AI\-driven automation and cognitive solutions
* Conducting complex data analysis to discern patterns and inform decision\-making
* Applying programming languages to build scalable AI and machine learning solutions
* Confirming data quality and integrity throughout the development process
* Engaging in active listening and accepting feedback to enhance personal growth and team performance
* Building commercial awareness by understanding how the business works and its impact on client solutions
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 1 years of experience


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Artificial Intelligence/Robotics, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
* At least one of the following: Certifications aligned to data engineering, machine learning, and cloud platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or related data and AI credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in Python and Scikit\-Learn for machine learning
* Utilizing AI implementation skills in client\-facing projects
* Engaging in complex data analysis and data modeling
* Applying machine learning libraries to enhance data\-driven solutions
* Adapting to fast\-paced environments with diverse client needs


 The salary range for this position is: $63,000 \- $140,000\. **Position Summary**
 Seeking a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience in Python, GCP, BigQuery, Data Engineering, and emerging GenAI technologies. The candidate should be capable of building cloud\-native applications, supporting data pipelines, developing AI\-enabled solutions, and collaborating within Agile teams
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 3 years of experience in Big Data technologies like GCP and AIML/GenAI
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain cloud\-native applications on GCP.
* Develop BigQuery\-based analytics and data processing solutions.
* Create and support AI/ML and GenAI prototypes.
* Build APIs and integrations for AI\-enabled applications.
* Participate in design, development, testing, and production support activities.
* Collaborate with business, data, and product teams to deliver solutions.


**Required Skills**
* Python
* SQL / BigQuery
* GCP (Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Vertex AI)
* Basic Machine Learning concepts
* Prompt Engineering
* RAG fundamentals
* REST API development

**About Pinterest**
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
   

  

 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
   

  

 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
   

  

 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
   

  

 The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.
   

  

 At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M\+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi\-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.
   

  

 Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations \- ensuring these models are safe, bias\-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies \- to championing ML Fairness and developing user\-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user\-controllable skin tone, hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type.
   

  

 You’ll help shape forward\-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.
* Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.
* Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R\-AI space.
* Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.


**What We're Looking For**
* Extensive, real\-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology \- spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
* Deep familiarity with cutting\-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer\-based models, 2\-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large\-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
* Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state\-of\-the\-art research with tangible product impact.
* 2\+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large\-scale ML\-driven user\-facing products
* Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields


**Nice To Have**
* Publications at top ML conferences
* Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring
* Familiarity with LLM\-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration
* Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data
* Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

**About Pinterest**
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
   

  

 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
   

  

 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
   

  

 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
   

  

 The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.
   

  

 At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M\+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi\-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.
   

  

 Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations \- ensuring these models are safe, bias\-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies \- to championing ML Fairness and developing user\-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user\-controllable skin tone, hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type.
   

  

 You’ll help shape forward\-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.
* Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.
* Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R\-AI space.
* Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.


**What We're Looking For**
* Extensive, real\-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology \- spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
* Deep familiarity with cutting\-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer\-based models, 2\-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large\-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
* Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state\-of\-the\-art research with tangible product impact.
* 2\+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large\-scale ML\-driven user\-facing products
* Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields


**Nice To Have**
* Publications at top ML conferences
* Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring
* Familiarity with LLM\-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration
* Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data
* Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

At Kenco Logistics, you’re more than just a team member—you’re part of a company that values innovation, integrity, and a strong commitment to its people. As one of the leading 3PL providers in the U.S., Kenco offers a dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. With a focus on safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement, Kenco empowers employees to make a real impact in the supply chain industry while building rewarding careers. Join a company where your contributions help move the world forward—one shipment at a time.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The Software Engineer \- Analytics will support the Analytics and Operations teams in solving business needs, integrating data systems, developing Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), full\-stack software, and communicate insights and/or solution recommendations. The role is expected to participate in the planning, design, and implementation of software/automation projects. The position will develop optimal system\-to\-system communications ranging from SQL/NoSQL databases, streaming systems, and distributed in\-memory calculation engines (Spark/Dask). The Analytics Software Engineer will design elegant, interactive web applications that are intuitive and user\-friendly across internal and external audiences.
   

  

**Functions**
* Partners with distribution, transportation, and material handling teams to identify opportunities for improvement through software and automation.
* Leads end\-to\-end software projects, evaluates trade\-offs, makes informed technical decisions, and iterates with business stakeholders.
* Identify, extract, assess, manipulate, and analyze internal and external data from multiple sources including transactional and reference data.
* Designs high\-performance, high\-volume and high\-velocity data pipelines with a strong focus on user experience.
* Supports large\-scale analytics initiatives, from exploratory data analysis to deployment of distributed solutions.
* Apply business knowledge to identify bad data and develop processes to increase data quality/integrity.
* Develops scalable and reliable analytics, tools, KPI dashboards, and metrics that drive key supply chain, financial, and procurement decisions.
* Provides root cause analysis of system and software faults to foster a cycle of continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field. Master’s preferred, or equivalent practical experience and demonstrated passion.
* 1–3 years of full\-stack software engineering experience, preferably in an analytics\-focused environment.
* Proficient in at least two of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Go, C\+\+, or Rust.
* Strong foundation in clean, maintainable coding practices.
* Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases, as well as distributed systems.
* Experience in designing and managing APIs, including version control and change management.
* Ability to shift between high\-level system design and hands\-on implementation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with cloud services (AWS preferred).
* Familiarity with Linux, Docker, and build/deployment automation.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of UI/UX design; experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue) is a plus.
* Strong user\-experience orientation and customer\-first mindset.


**Benefits Offered**
* Medical insurance including HSA, HRA and FSA accounts
* Supplemental insurance including critical illness, hospital indemnity, accidental injury
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic Life and Supplemental Life
* Short Term and Long Term Disability
* Paid Parental Leave
* 401(k)
* Paid Time Off approximately 2 weeks (accrual begins on Day 1 of employment)
* Employer Paid Holidays\- 10 days

Peregrine Advisors is a firm founded on a simple conviction: the best solutions come from the people closest to the problem, given real ownership and the tools to deliver. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution.
 



  





**Your first assignment** 




 Your first assignment will likely have you taking user stories from refinement all the way to production by:
 


* building serverless, event\-driven application workflows, cloud\-native on AWS, with Lambda and Step Functions;
* connecting commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) products into the larger system frameworks developed in\-house;
* building API connections, whether internal or external, that support modern system architectures; or
* creating data and document pipelines that make automatic what used to be manual and paper\-heavy.



 Adaptability and a demonstrated capacity to learn new concepts, systems, and tools are what keep you ahead of program needs as projects complete and priorities shift.
 



 The work is real, hard, and it matters. It is also where you start, not the shape of your career here: we hire people, not seats, and we move our best to where the hardest problems are.
 



  





**What you'll build** 



* Cloud\-native, modern systems whose streamlined, automated operation creates exceptional business value.
* Tested, working code you own all the way to production, including the defects you uncover and correct along the way.
* Automation that retires manual process, the validations, checks, and workflows that once lived in somebody's spreadsheet.
* Routine deployments, with services shipped through pipelines instead of through events.
* AI\-assisted development as the default way of working, with tools like Amazon Q Developer across the entire lifecycle.
* And over time, the firm itself, through the new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help launch.



  





**Who you are** 




 You care about what you build and judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. As priorities move, you move with them, treating each new tool and domain as an opportunity to improve your craft. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.
 



  





**What you bring** 



* A practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to build something new or make an existing system work better.
* The matching delivery habits, meaning version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility.
* Plain\-language communication about your work with the people who depend on it, explaining clearly and listening for what they need.
* The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.



  





**What you'll need** 




 Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, the years, the certifications, the specific tools, we ask in the application and get into during the interview.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 A high\-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real\-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands\-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years.
 



  





**What we commit to** 




 As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.
 



 We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
 



 Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.
 



*Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles.* 




  





**Requirements** 



* 4\+ years of software development experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Working\-level command of Python
* Experience with modern languages and frameworks, and with version control
* Familiarity with cloud development on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts
* Ability to turn a defined specification into working, tested code and own it through to production
* Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel



  





**Preferred** 



* Amazon Web Services exposure or certification
* Federal information technology experience
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling

**About Thinking Machines** 




 The mission of Thinking Machines is to build AI that extends human will and judgment. We are training frontier models with Inkling, developing Tinker to let people make models their own, and crafting interfaces that broaden human\-AI communication. We believe the future worth building is human, and we're hiring people who want to build it.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're hiring a Software Engineer to sit at the day\-to\-day interface between research and infrastructure. This is a generalist role with broad scope: you'll be one of the people always in the room for infra decisions on the ML systems side, with a clear enough view of upcoming compute needs to see support burden coming before it arrives.
 



  





 You'll also be one of the people who babysits hero runs — the ones at 2am when a 4k\-GPU job hits a weird Xid and someone needs to decide, quickly and correctly, whether to drain the node, restart the job, or escalate to NVIDIA before the run loses checkpoints. That kind of judgment, built across the kernel, the network, the scheduler, and the application layer, is the core of the job.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Debug across the full stack — kernel, NCCL, scheduler, application, and telemetry — often in the same afternoon, to find root causes that don't show up in any single layer
* Provide embedded, hands\-on support during hero runs and major incidents, staying with a problem until it's genuinely resolved
* Serve as the front door for researchers when something's broken and it isn't obvious who owns it
* Lead postmortems and build the tooling that prevents the next incident — acting as a force multiplier, not just a responder
* Mentor other engineers into this kind of cross\-stack breadth

**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Credible, hands\-on competence in 4 or more of the following: Linux kernel, networking, GPUs / CUDA, distributed systems runtimes, storage, compilers / language runtimes, observability internals — at this level, this required range is the qualifying signal
* Comfort operating without a clearly defined owner, and the judgment to know when to dig in yourself versus when to escalate



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Track record of being the person other engineers escalate to, across 2\+ companies
* Shipped meaningful contributions in 3\+ distinct technical stacks
* Track record of leading major incidents where the root cause was non\-obvious
* Researcher\-facing comfort: can talk to a researcher about their workload without making them feel dumb, and can tell them no when the right answer is no
* Experience operating at the scale of frontier training or inference clusters, and appetite for owning the hardest, least\-defined problems in that stack

One Robot builds task\-specific world models and an evaluation platform for robot manipulation policies.
   

  

 Training end\-to\-end policies for robots is vibes\-based today. Teams collect data, train, deploy on a real robot, find out what fails, collect more, retry. We replace the trial\-and\-error with rigorous validation that tells you where your policy will fail and what data to collect to fix it.
   

  

 Robotics can't industrialize without an evaluation layer. We're building it.
   

  

 We're solving challenging technical problems around long\-horizon autoregressive generation, world model controllability, and closing the sim\-to\-real gap. We work with real customer data, real failures, and real deployment pressure.
   

  

 We're based in San Francisco, backed by Accel, YC, several exited founders, and engineering leaders at leading AI companies.
   

  

 We're small and deliberately so. Everyone is an IC with deep ownership of a wide surface area. The culture is fast iteration and direct responsibility.
   

  

 Hemanth Sarabu and Elton Shon co\-founded One Robot after leading robot learning together at Industrial Next (YC W22\), bringing experience from Google, NASA JPL, and Tesla.
   

  

 We're building the evaluation layer to understand policy failure modes before they hit production. You'll own modeling work that makes the eval trustworthy.

* Train evaluation models: Develop VLMs that classify and verify policy behavior.
* Build confidence layers: Convert model outputs into trustworthy signals the customer can act on.
* Improve model grounding: Make the eval models reason accurately about physical and spatial scenes.
* Build a self\-improving eval layer: Develop data engine that makes the eval models sharper with each customer's deployments and corrections.


**Requirements:**
* Very strong coding in Python and PyTorch.
* VLM/LLM training: Track record in training VLMs or LLMs.
* Evals experience: Developed and shipped evals for VLMs or LLMs.

****America is strongest when ability can rise****
 The right person can change the trajectory of a team, a company, or an entire field.
   

  

 But most hiring systems are built to avoid mistakes, not to discover extraordinary upside. They rely on the credentials that are easiest to read: the right degree, the right previous employer, or the right personal network. These filters, while convenient, are often very poor proxies for what someone can actually do.
   

  

 When exceptional ability is missed, the loss is larger than one denied opportunity. A company loses performance. Coworkers lose a force multiplier. Ideas and businesses that could have existed never get built. A country that mistakes pedigree for ability does not merely distribute opportunity unfairly, it leaves growth on the table.
   

  

 History suggests that better talent allocation has been a major source of American growth. When capable people reach the work where they can contribute most, workers rise, companies become more productive, and the benefits can spread through new ideas, stronger teams, families, and communities.
   

  

 MeritFirst is building the infrastructure to make that the
 *default* 
 . We create objective, efficient ways for people to demonstrate critical thinking, problem\-solving, adaptability, and execution \- and help companies hire based on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree alone.
   

  

 For the worker, that means upward mobility. For the company, better performance. At scale, it can mean national growth.
   

  

****The role****
 MeritFirst’s product has to do something much harder than move information around: it has to create a signal that deserves to influence consequential decisions about people.
   

  

 Candidates must trust that they have a fair opportunity to demonstrate what they can do. Employers must trust that the resulting signal predicts performance better than the credentials they already use. Earning that trust requires exceptional product judgment, rigorous measurement, and software that is reliable, explainable, and built with care.
   

  

 We’re looking for Software Engineers to help build that system from first principles. You will work directly with our founder, product team, candidates, and employers to shape and build the MeritFirst platform \- from the candidate experience and assessment engine to employer workflows, evaluation systems, and the infrastructure beneath them.
   

  

 This is not a role where a roadmap arrives fully specified. You will help determine what should exist, reduce ambiguous problems to their essential parts, ship the first version, observe how it behaves in the real world, and improve it quickly.
   

  

 One day you may be designing a new assessment experience. The next, you may be debugging an edge case in production, working through an evaluation methodology with an assessment expert, simplifying an employer
 *workflow* 
 , or deciding which manual process should become software.
   

  

 AI gives engineers extraordinary new leverage, and we intend to use it. But our standard is not code that looks plausible or was produced quickly. It is a system we understand, can explain, can test, and can trust.
   

  

 We expect our engineering team to have deep technical foundations while using modern tools to multiply judgment not replace it.
   

  

****What you’ll build over time****
 The responsibilities below describe the full mandate of the engineering function over time, not a day\-one checklist for one person.
   

  

 You will begin by taking ownership of the highest\-leverage product and technical problems, shipping directly to users, and developing a deep understanding of where software can most improve the candidate\-to\-hire
 *loop* 
 . From there, you will help build the systems and engineering team that allow MeritFirst to scale.
   

  

* Build the core product. Create candidate and employer experiences that make it easy to demonstrate ability, understand the resulting signal, and act on it.
* Build a flexible assessment platform. Develop the primitives that allow us to create, deliver, evaluate, and continuously improve rigorous assessments and realistic work challenges across many kinds of roles.
* Own problems end to end. Move from understanding the user and shaping the product through system design, implementation, deployment, observation, and iteration. You will own outcomes, not tickets.
* Turn difficult human workflows into excellent software. Work closely with assessment experts, operators, and users to understand what should be automated, what should remain human, and how the two should fit together.
* Build evaluation systems worthy of trust. Make results consistent, interpretable, auditable, and resistant to gaming. Design appropriate human review, testing, and safeguards into systems that affect real careers.
* Close the learning loop. Connect assessment performance, employer decisions, and on\-the\-job outcomes so the product becomes more useful and predictive over time.
* Use AI where it earns its place. Apply models where they materially improve assessment creation, evaluation, or the candidate and employer experience \- and build the evaluations and guardrails required to know whether they are actually working.
* Make trust a technical requirement. Treat reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, and candidate experience as foundational product properties rather than cleanup work.
* Strengthen the technical foundation. Improve architecture, testing, observability, performance, and developer velocity where the business requires it \- without prematurely building infrastructure we do not yet need.
* Set the engineering standard. Establish the technical judgment, operating habits, and quality bar that future engineers will inherit. Help us identify and recruit the people who should join you.


****Who will thrive here****
 You may have been an early engineer, technical founder, or senior individual contributor. You may have built an ambitious product at a startup, owned a critical system at scale, made meaningful open\-source contributions, or developed exceptional ability outside a conventional path.
   

  

 Your exact background matters less than evidence of unusual technical ability, product judgment, and ownership.
   

  

 You will likely thrive here if:
   

  

* You have built and operated meaningful production software, not only prototypes or narrowly bounded features.
* You have exceptional technical foundations and can reason from first principles when existing abstractions stop helping.
* You can move fluidly between shaping the product, designing the system, writing the code, reading unfamiliar code, and understanding what happens in production.
* You have depth in at least one part of the stack and enough range to follow important problems wherever they lead.
* You are an excellent debugger. When something behaves unexpectedly, you form hypotheses, follow evidence, and keep going until you understand why.
* You combine speed with judgment. You know when to build the simplest thing that works, when to invest in a foundation, and how to avoid both perfectionism and careless debt.
* You have strong product instincts and care deeply about the person on the other side of the screen.
* You have built production software both with and without AI assistance. You understand where these tools create extraordinary leverage and where they can conceal shallow reasoning, brittle code, or false confidence.
* You treat AI\-generated code like code written by someone you have never worked with: inspect it, test it, and take full responsibility for it.
* You communicate clearly, disagree directly, and make technical tradeoffs legible to non\-engineers.
* You want your work to matter in the real world and care deeply about our mission.


****This may not be the right role if****
* You want requirements, architecture, and priorities to be fully specified before you begin.
* You prefer to remain within a narrow technical layer or consider product, user research, support, data work, or operations outside your job.
* You measure engineering quality primarily by code volume, feature count, or how quickly something can be generated.
* You rely on frameworks or AI tools without being able to explain, debug, and own the systems they help produce.
* You reach for elaborate architecture before understanding the problem or finding evidence that the scale requires it.
* You enjoy greenfield building but lose interest in operating, repairing, and improving what you ship.
* You want an established engineering organization, mature infrastructure, and settled operating playbook.
* You are looking for a predictable 9\-to\-5\. We care about sustainable performance, but building an ambitious company from the ground up will sometimes require long days and exceptional intensity.
* You are more interested in the idea of meritocracy \- or the current excitement around AI \- than the difficult technical work required to build something people can trust.


****Logistics****
 We practice what we preach: our hiring process is designed to surface demonstrated ability, not reward pedigree or interview polish. We care far more about what you can do rather than where you went to school or which logos appear on your resume.
   

  

 You’ll move from a short initial screen to a conversation with a team member, a deeper role\-relevant technical exercise, and final\-round conversations focused on technical judgment, product sense, ownership, and mutual fit.
   

  

 We may ask you to work both with and without AI assistance. We are not testing nostalgia or typing speed \- we want to understand your technical foundations, how you reason, and how you use modern tools without surrendering judgment.
   

  

 Along the way, you’ll experience the MeritFirst product firsthand, giving you a chance to evaluate what we’re building \- and whether you’re excited to help shape it!
